q: What's the difference between a Fellowship and a YPGT?
What is a YPGT?
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng Fellowship at YPGT?
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng YPGT?
What kind of events do you have?
a_en: We have two kinds of gatherings. A YP Fellowship is our regular meet — worship, the Word, a topic or teaching, and sharing — usually 2:30 PM on the 2nd or 3rd week of the month at the church. A YPGT (Young Pro Get-Together) is our monthly outing — coffee, swimming, museum tours, food, hobby/fitness — building real friendships outside the four walls. Both are open to everyone!
a_tl: May dalawang uri kami ng gathering. Ang YP Fellowship ay ang regular naming pagkikita — worship, ang Salita ng Diyos, isang topic o aral, at sharing — kadalasan 2:30 PM tuwing 2nd o 3rd week ng buwan sa church. Ang YPGT (Young Pro Get-Together) naman ay ang buwanang lakad namin — kape, swimming, museum tour, pagkain, hobby/fitness — para bumuo ng tunay na pagkakaibigan sa labas ng simbahan. Bukas ang dalawa sa lahat!
